outcomes.text: DRAFT. What building costs holders: keeper pay is a fixed quote per operation (D56, D57): quoted gas at min(basefee + 0.05 gwei, 0.5 gwei ceiling; 2 gwei for redemption and wind-down work) plus a flat 0.00002 ETH per unit of work, no premium; never the caller's measured gas. Quoted gas is at most 1.75M per position built and listed in keeper-sized batches. Units: 1 per pack built and per position listed, 2 per bid cycle (resolve and relist), 1 per pricing checkpoint (quoted at measured gas, D61), 1 per position unlisted or item liquidated. At the ceiling a build costs at most about 0.0009 ETH per position. Splitting calls earns no extra base worth its gas; budgets cap all pay at 0.041 ETH a day; the owner can stop pay at once.

DRAFT. How it ends for holders: after wind-down each holder's claim equals their share of the vault's value to the wei (value priced before that checkpoint's keeper pay, which falls on the shares that stay), and no shares are left locked.
DRAFT. What is left at the end: only the dead-share seed slice remains in the vault, about 0.0105 ETH (the 0.01 ETH seed plus deploy-address dust).

DRAFT. Liabilities are never deployable (D32): escrowed deposits, redemption and distribution reserves and settled-but-unclaimed ETH never become spendable. Checked after every keeper call in every regime (the test fails otherwise) and measured here with an entitlement settled to claimable: spendable ETH above the unowed balance is 0 wei.

DRAFT. Can it stall and what restarts it (gas): no call is refused for gas price. Routine work is paid up to the 0.5 gwei ceiling and redemption and wind-down work up to 2 gwei (D61), from the essential budget; above those the keeper waits and holders or anyone may act at their own extra cost (a deposit-pricing checkpoint at 2 gwei is paid as at 0.5 gwei). A failing keeper policy never blocks work: it pays 0 and the call still runs. Claims are the holder's own, unpaid. Work resumes when gas falls or the owner raises a ceiling (immediate, D58).
DRAFT. FWA token rewards (D43): claimed and burned, never sold. Supply falls by exactly the claimed amount and the burn pays the caller no ETH, so holders pay no gas and get no token value.

DRAFT. Oracle failure cannot trap assets (D34): with FWA's floor oracle repointed so no quote can be read, nothing new lists unless FWA exempts the collection from its oracle (then no cap applies, D62), yet the kicked pack is back in inventory and a holder redeeming everything is paid (measured 0.9975 ETH of a 1 ETH deposit).

DRAFT. What a holder pays if nothing is ever bought: entering, building, unwinding and exiting with zero acquisitions costs holders at most 1.5% of deposits (measured 0.46%: Shapes mint fees and keeper gas).
